mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which is positive for corporate earnings and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, which is positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 2% MoM and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% year-over-year, it indicates a mismatch between monetary policy and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a strong labor market, which is positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% quarter-over-quarter signals strong demand in the housing market, which is positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% QoQ and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) is decreasing, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and INDPRO decreasing
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and INDPRO decreasing and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.
